arxiv-2102-01639.title: Ambient Backscatter-Assisted Wireless-Powered Relaying Thanks: Some initial results of this paper have been accepted by the IEEE International Conference on Communications in 2018 [ 1 ]
arxiv-2102-01639.creator: Xiao Lu, Dusit Niyato, Hai Jiang, Ekram Hossain, Ping Wang
arxiv-2102-01639.description: Abstract Internet-of-Things (IoT) is featured with low-power communications among a massive number of ubiquitously-deployed and energy-constrained electronics, e.g., sensors and actuators. To cope with the demand, wireless-powered cooperative relaying emerges as a promising communication paradigm to extend data transmission coverage and solve energy scarcity for the IoT devices.

arxiv-2107-08336.title: quicSDN: Transitioning from TCP to QUIC for Southbound Communication in SDNs
arxiv-2107-08336.creator: Puneet Kumar and Behnam Dezfouli
arxiv-2107-08336.description: Abstract In Software-Defined Networks (SDNs), the control plane and data plane communicate for various purposes, such as applying configurations and collecting statistical data. While various methods have been proposed to reduce the overhead and enhance the scalability of SDNs, the impact of the transport layer protocol used for southbound communication has not been investigated.

arxiv-2307-00363.title: On the Complexity of Robust Eventual Inequality Testing for C-Finite Functions
arxiv-2307-00363.creator: Eike Neumann
arxiv-2307-00363.description: Abstract We study the computational complexity of a robust version of the problem of testing two univariate C-finite functions for eventual inequality at large times. Specifically, working in the bit-model of real computation, we consider the eventual inequality testing problem for real functions that are specified by homogeneous linear Cauchy problems with arbitrary real coefficients and initial values.

arxiv-2310-08587.title: Pseudo-Generalized Dynamic View Synthesis from a Video
arxiv-2310-08587.creator: Xiaoming Zhao Alex Colburn Fangchang Ma Miguel Ángel Bautista, Joshua M. Susskind Alexander G. Schwing
arxiv-2310-08587.description: Abstract Rendering scenes observed in a monocular video from novel viewpoints is a challenging problem. For static scenes the community has studied both scene-specific optimization techniques, which optimize on every test scene, and generalized techniques, which only run a deep net forward pass on a test scene.

pmc-10517896.title: Determining and predicting feed intake in crossbred sheep from weaning until maturity
pmc-10517896.creator: PG Theron, TS Brand, SWP Cloete, JHC van Zyl
pmc-10517896.description: Access to simple, accurate feed intake models would facilitate decision-making in feedlots as feed costs are a major part of operational expenditure. This study aimed to develop genotype-specific feed intake models for South African feedlot lambs. Four ram and four ewe lambs each of eight genotypes were raised under ideal growth conditions from weaning until 1 year of age.

pmc-11434390.title: Investigating the Mechanisms of 15-PGDH Inhibitor SW033291 in Improving Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Insights from Metabolomics and Transcriptomics
pmc-11434390.creator: Yuanfeng Huang, Mingjie Liang, Yiwen Liao, Zirui Ji, Wanfen Lin, Xiangjin Pu, Lexun Wang, Weixuan Wang, Takayuki Masaki
pmc-11434390.description: This study focused on exploring the effects of SW033291, an inhibitor of 15-hydroxyprostaglandin dehydrogenase, on type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) mice from a comprehensive perspective. Studies have demonstrated that SW033291 benefits tissue repair, organ function, and muscle mass in elderly mice. Our recent investigation initially reported the beneficial effect of SW033291 on T2DM progression.

pmc-12607182.title: A case of acute pulmonary edema in scrub typhus: a rare complication with normal cardiac and renal function
pmc-12607182.creator: Kajananan Sivagurunathan, Nishadi Perera, Anuranga Senanayake
pmc-12607182.description: BackgroundScrub typhus is a mite-borne rickettsial infection endemic to parts of Asia, including Sri Lanka, with a wide range of clinical manifestations.Case presentationWe report a rare case of a 16-year-old male who presented with a seven-day febrile illness complicated by hypoxemia and pulmonary congestion.

pmc-13247796.description: Aim:To examine the relationship between access to routine primary healthcare (PHC) and receipt of dental visits.Background:PHC plays a vital role in promoting overall health and connecting patients to preventive services. Regular dental visits are crucial for preventing oral health issues and managing chronic diseases associated with oral health.

pmc-13376225.title: Steel Based Precious Group Metal‐Free High‐Performance Electrodes for Alkaline Exchange Membrane Water Electrolysis
pmc-13376225.creator: Lukas Heinius, Pierre Schröer, Vincent Wilke, Merel Rittel, Quy Duy Doan, Chen Yie Thum, Raffaele Amitrano, Christian M Günther, Johannes Schmidt, Duc Van Dinh, Dominik Dworschak, Aldo Saul Gago, Kaspar Andreas Friedrich, Fabio Dionigi, Peter Strasser
pmc-13376225.description: The development of platinum‐group‐metal (PGM)‐free electrodes is essential for cost‐effective alkaline water electrolysis. Herein, we report steel‐based electrodes for a fully PGM‐free, ionomer‐free anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEMWE). A Ni layer deposited on stainless steel (ss) was modified via hydrothermal NiMo growth followed by reductive annealing, yielding a hierarchical NiMo@ss catalyst.

pmc-13392069.title: Cycling of Fe(II)/Fe(III) in the euphotic zone mediated by mineral photocatalysis
pmc-13392069.creator: Tong Liu, Hongrui Ding, Anhuai Lu, Lingzi Meng, Xiao Ge, Ying Liu, Fangchao Zhu, Shuo Yu, Qunjian Yin, Yan Li, Changqiu Wang, Juan Liu, Song Jin
pmc-13392069.description: The marine iron cycle is now recognized as fast and dynamic, partly fueled by vast particulate iron inputs. Yet the mechanisms that activate this reservoir to sustain productivity remain unresolved. Here we show that mineral photocatalysis, an overlooked abiotic process, provides a key activation pathway for Fe(II) production.

pmc-13486348.title: Insights on the cellular mechanisms of intracranial electrical stimulation using optical imaging in preclinical models☆
pmc-13486348.creator: Cara Ravasio, Mohammed Abumuaileq, Mohigul Nasimova, Jiancheng Xie, Dana C Shaw, Audrey Lindsay, Catherine J Chu, Xue Han
pmc-13486348.description: Intracranial electrical stimulation is increasingly used to treat neurological and psychiatric conditions. However, the underlying therapeutic mechanisms at the cellular and circuit levels remain poorly understood. Exciting progress in the development of genetically encoded neural activity indicators enables artifact-free, high-spatiotemporal-resolution optical analysis of the impact of intracranial stimulation on membrane potentials, cytosolic calcium, and neurotransmitter and neuromodulator dynamics.

pmc-13678839.title: Human Bone Morphogenetic Protein‐3 Mature Ligand Is Larger Than Recorded Indicating Earlier Publications Are Flawed
pmc-13678839.creator: David E. Phelan, Caitriona Scaife, Emma R. Dorris, John Russell, Madeline Murphy
pmc-13678839.description: Bone morphogenetic protein (BMP)‐3 (osteogenin) is an important regulatory cytokine during development and acts as a tumor suppressor in several cancers. BMPs are synthesized as proproteins that are cleaved by proprotein convertases to release biologically active ligands. The BMP‐3 mature ligand is recorded as 16 kDa consisting of carboxy‐terminal Q363‐R472 (110 amino acids).

pmc-13722264.title: Oral health status and treatment needs of pregnant women attending primary and tertiary healthcare centres of Telangana, India: A population-based cross-sectional study
pmc-13722264.creator: V Pranitha, Anurag Negi, Frijo Xavier, Vijay Yadav, Nabnita Patnaik, G N Kusneniwar, Badam Vijomai, Kavita Chandrasekaran, Shruthi Nayak, M R Rakhi
pmc-13722264.description: Context:Maternal oral health plays an important role in pregnancy outcomes but is often overlooked in antenatal care in India.Aims:This study aimed to assess and compare oral health status and treatment needs among pregnant women attending primary and tertiary healthcare centres in Telangana.
